articles.title: EToro invests in onchain derivatives platform Extended as brokers race into DeFi
articles.snippet: The broker plans to bring perpetual futures into Zengo wallet and expand DeFi products to its core platform as rivals like Robinhood expand onchain offerings.

articles.title: Bitwise says STRC selloff signals crypto cycle nearing a bottom, not Strategy’s breaking point
articles.snippet: Bitwise said STRC's volatility reflects a late-cycle leverage unwind, with institutions poised to replace Strategy as bitcoin's biggest buyer.

articles.title: SBI Crypto to shut down mining pool that holds roughly 2% of Bitcoin's hashrate
articles.snippet: Miners must redirect their hashrate before the July 31 cutoff, as the pool will stop accepting contributions after that date.

articles.title: Smaller tokens lead as bitcoin, sol rally in 'first real bounce of the selloff'
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and major cryptocurrencies rebounded on dovish Federal Reserve signals, with speculative tokens like Memecore’s M and Audiera’s BEAT leading gains.

articles.title: ChatGPT developer OpenAI said to discuss offering U.S. government a 5% stake: FT
articles.snippet: The proposal aims to give the American public a financial stake in AI while easing political scrutiny of the industry.
